duas.arabic_text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillahilladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin nushur

translations.en: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after death and to Him is the return.

duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsayna wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilaykan nushur

translations.en: O Allah, by You we enter the morning, by You we enter the evening, by You we live, by You we die, and to You is the return.

duas.arabic_text: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيًّا
duas.transliteration: Radeetu billahi rabban wa bil-Islami deenan wa bi Muhammadin nabiyya

translations.en: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad as my Prophet.

duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni asbahtu ush-hiduka wa ush-hidu hamalata arshika wa mala'ikataka wa jamee'a khalqika annaka antallahu la ilaha illa anta wahdaka la sharika laka wa anna Muhammadan abduka wa rasuluk

translations.en: O Allah, I have entered the morning calling You, the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels, and all of Your creation to witness that You are Allah, there is no god but You alone without partner, and that Muhammad is Your servant and messenger.

duas.arabic_text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
duas.transliteration: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi adada khalqihi wa rida nafsihi wa zinata arshihi wa midada kalimatih

translations.en: Glory and praise be to Allah, as many times as the number of His creation, as His pleasure, as the weight of His Throne, and as the ink of His words.

duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aafini fi badani, Allahumma aafini fi sam'i, Allahumma aafini fi basari, la ilaha illa ant

translations.en: O Allah, grant my body health. O Allah, grant my hearing health. O Allah, grant my sight health. There is no god but You.

duas.arabic_text: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
duas.transliteration: Bismikallahumma amutu wa ahya

translations.en: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma qini azabaka yawma tab'athu ibadak

translations.en: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day You resurrect Your servants.

duas.arabic_text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillahilladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin nushur

translations.en: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after death and to Him is the return.

duas.arabic_text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi walajna wa bismillahi kharajna wa alallahi rabbina tawakkalna

translations.en: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we rely.

duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلَجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayral mawlaji wa khayral makhraji bismillahi walajna wa bismillahi kharajna wa alallahi rabbina tawakkalna

translations.en: O Allah, I ask You for the best of entering and the best of leaving. In Your name we enter, in Your name we leave, and upon our Lord we rely.

duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal khubuthi wal khaba'ith

translations.en: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from male and female devils.

duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma iftah li abwaba rahmatik

translations.en: O Allah, open the doors of Your mercy for me.

duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik

translations.en: O Allah, I ask You for Your bounty.

duas.arabic_text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi wassalatu wassalamu ala rasulillah

translations.en: In the name of Allah, and peace and blessings be upon the Messenger of Allah.

duas.arabic_text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah

translations.en: In the name of Allah.

duas.arabic_text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مِنْ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillahilladhi at'amana wa saqana wa ja'alana minal muslimeen

translations.en: All praise is for Allah who fed us, gave us drink, and made us Muslims.

duas.arabic_text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fih

translations.en: All praise is for Allah, much, good and blessed praise.

duas.arabic_text: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu al-azim al-haleem, la ilaha illallahu rabbul arshil azim, la ilaha illallahu rabbus samawati wa rabbul ardi wa rabbul arshil kareem

translations.en: There is no god but Allah, the Almighty, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.

duas.benefit: Recited during times of distress and anxiety

duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma rahmataka arju fala takilni ila nafsi tarfata aynin wa aslih li sha'ni kullahu la ilaha illa ant

translations.en: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy, so do not leave me to myself for the blink of an eye, and set right all my affairs. There is no god but You.

duas.arabic_text: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
duas.transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyumu birahmatika astaghith

translations.en: O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining, by Your mercy I seek help.

duas.arabic_text: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahi tammati min sharri ma khalaq

translations.en: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

duas.arabic_text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahilladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil ardi wa la fis sama'i wa huwas samee'ul 'aleem

translations.en: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal hammi wal hazani wa a'udhu bika minal 'ajzi wal kasali wa a'udhu bika minal jubni wal bukhli wa a'udhu bika min ghalabatid dayni wa qahrir rijal

translations.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from weakness and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, from the burden of debt and the oppression of men.

duas.arabic_text: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ * اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ * لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ * وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
duas.transliteration: Qul huwallahu ahad, Allahus samad, lam yalid wa lam yulad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad

translations.en: Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal, the Absolute. He neither begets nor is born, nor is there to Him any equivalent.

duas.benefit: Recited morning and evening for protection

duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
duas.transliteration: Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar. Subhanalladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun

translations.en: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could never have done it by ourselves. Truly, to our Lord we shall return.

duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنْ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadha al-birra wat-taqwa wa minal 'amali ma tarda. Allahumma hawwin alayna safarana hadha watwi 'anna bu'dah

translations.en: O Allah, we ask You for righteousness, piety, and actions that please You during this journey. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance.

duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma antas sahibu fis safari wal khalifatu fil ahli

translations.en: O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the Guardian over the family.

tasbih_presets.label: La ilaha illallah
tasbih_presets.translation: There is no god but Allah

tasbih_presets.label: SubhanAllah wa bihamdihi
tasbih_presets.translation: Glory and praise be to Allah

tasbih_presets.label: La hawla wa la quwwata
tasbih_presets.arabic_text: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
tasbih_presets.transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
tasbih_presets.translation: There is no power nor strength except with Allah

asma_ul_husna.explanation: The One who bestows countless blessings upon all creation without discrimination.
The One whose mercy is especially reserved for the believers.
The Sovereign Lord, the Owner of all creation.
The Pure One, free from all imperfections.
The One who gives peace and security to all creation.
The One who bestows faith and security upon His creation.
The One who watches over and protects all things.
The Omnipotent, the Invincible.
The One who compels all things according to His will.
The One who is majestic and possesses all greatness.
The One who creates everything from nothing.
The One who brings creation into existence with perfect order.
The One who gives each creation its distinctive form.
The One who repeatedly forgives sins and covers faults.
The One who dominates all things and prevails over all.
The One who gives generously without expecting anything in return.
The One who provides sustenance for all creatures.
The One who opens doors of mercy, provisions, and solutions.
The One who knows everything, the apparent and the hidden.
The One who restricts sustenance and provisions as He wills.
The One who expands and increases provisions for whom He wills.
The One who lowers and humbles the arrogant.
The One who raises the ranks of the righteous.
The One who grants honor and dignity to whom He wills.
The One who humiliates the arrogant and tyrants.
The One who hears all sounds, whispers, and prayers.
The One who sees all things, no matter how small.
The One who judges with absolute justice.
The One who is perfectly just in all matters.
The One who is kind and gentle, aware of the finest details.
The One who is fully aware of all hidden realities.
The One who is patient and does not hasten punishment.
The One whose greatness is beyond comprehension.
The One who forgives all sins for those who repent.
The One who rewards good deeds abundantly.
The One whose rank is supreme and exalted.
The One who is greatest in every way.
The One who preserves and protects all things.
The One who provides nourishment and sustenance.
The One who takes account of all deeds.
The One who possesses absolute majesty and grandeur.
The One who is infinitely generous and noble.
The One who watches over all creation at all times.
The One who answers the prayers of those who call upon Him.
The One whose mercy, knowledge, and power encompass everything.
The One who is perfect in wisdom in all His actions.
The One who loves His righteous servants and is beloved to them.
The One whose glory and honor are supreme.
The One who resurrects the dead on the Day of Judgment.
The One who witnesses everything that happens.
The One whose existence is absolute truth.
The One to rely upon for all affairs.
The One whose strength is limitless.
The One whose power is severe and unyielding.
The One who is the protecting friend of the believers.
The One who is praised for all His actions.
The One who keeps count of all things.
The One who begins creation from nothing.
The One who repeats and restores creation.
The One who gives life to all living beings.
The One who causes death to all living beings.
The One who is eternally alive and never dies.
The One who sustains all existence without need.
The One who finds whatever He seeks, nothing escapes Him.
The One whose nobility, honor, and generosity are immense.
The One who is unique and has no partner.
The One to whom all creation turns for their needs.
The One who has power over all things.
The One who has complete power over all things.
The One who brings forward whom He wills.
The One who delays whom He wills.
The One who exists before all things.
The One who remains after all things cease.
The One whose existence is evident through His creation.
The One who is hidden from sensory perception.
The One who governs and manages all affairs.
The One who is far above any imperfection.
The One who is infinitely kind and benevolent.
The One who accepts repentance and forgives repeatedly.
The One who punishes those who persist in evil.
The One who pardons sins and overlooks faults.
The One who is full of compassion and kindness.
The One who owns all dominion and authority.

asma_ul_husna.meaning: The Lord of Majesty and Generosity
asma_ul_husna.explanation: The One who possesses both grandeur and generosity.
The One who deals with absolute fairness and justice.
The One who gathers all creation on the Day of Judgment.
The One who is free of all needs.
The One who enriches whom He wills.
The One who prevents harm as He wills.
The One who causes harm to test His creation.
The One who brings benefit to whom He wills.
The One who is the light of the heavens and the earth.
The One who guides whom He wills to the right path.
The One who creates with unparalleled beauty and innovation.
The One who remains forever, while all else perishes.
The One who inherits all things after creation ceases.
The One who guides all affairs to their right conclusion.
The One who is extremely patient and does not hasten punishment.
Begin and end with the Most Gracious, whose mercy encompasses all.

kalmas.name: Kalma Tayyiba
kalmas.arabic_text: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ

translations.en: There is no god but Allah, Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.
translations.ur: اللہ کے سوا کوئی معبود نہیں، محمد اللہ کے رسول ہیں

kalmas.benefits: The foundation of Islamic faith. Whoever recites it with sincerity enters Paradise.

kalmas.name: Kalma Shahadat
kalmas.arabic_text: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
kalmas.transliteration: Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluh

translations.en: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger.

kalmas.benefits: The testimony of faith that enters one into Islam.

kalmas.name: Kalma Tamjeed
kalmas.arabic_text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
kalmas.transliteration: SubhanAllah walhamdulillah wa la ilaha illallah wallahu akbar wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahil aliyyil azeem

translations.en: Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no power nor strength except with Allah, the Most High, the Most Great.

kalmas.benefits: A comprehensive praise of Allah that brings immense rewards.

kalmas.name: Kalma Tawheed
kalmas.arabic_text: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
kalmas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu yuhyi wa yumitu wa huwa hayyun la yamutu bi yadihil khayr wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadeer

translations.en: There is no god but Allah alone, He has no partner. His is the kingdom and His is the praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is the Living who does not die. In His hand is all good, and He has power over all things.

kalmas.name: Kalma Astaghfar
kalmas.arabic_text: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ رَبِّي مِنْ كُلِّ ذَنْبٍ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
kalmas.transliteration: Astaghfirullaha rabbi min kulli dhanbin wa atubu ilayh

translations.en: I seek forgiveness from Allah, my Lord, from every sin and I turn to Him in repentance.

kalmas.benefits: Seeks forgiveness from Allah and wipes away sins.

kalmas.name: Kalma Radd-e-Kufr
kalmas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ شَيْئًا وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا أَعْلَمُ تُبْتُ عَنْهُ وَتَبَرَّأْتُ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالشِّرْكِ وَالْكِذْبِ وَالْمَعَاصِي كُلِّهَا أَسْلَمْتُ وَآمَنْتُ وَأَقُولُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
kalmas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min an ushrika bika shay'an wa ana a'lam, wa astaghfiruka lima la a'lam, tubtu anhu wa tabarra'tu minal kufri wash-shirki wal-kidhbi wal-ma'asi kulliha, aslamtu wa amantu wa aqulu la ilaha illallah, Muhammadur Rasulullah

translations.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowingly associating partners with You, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do not know. I repent from it and I disassociate myself from disbelief, polytheism, falsehood, and all sins. I submit and I believe, and I declare: There is no god but Allah, Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.

kalmas.benefits: Renounces disbelief and reaffirms faith in Allah.

translations.en: Actions are judged by intentions.
The best among you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.
Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
The best way to find yourself is to lose yourself in the service of others.
Those who show mercy will be shown mercy by the Most Merciful.
Indeed, Allah is with the patient.
Gratitude for the little things brings abundant blessings.

daily_content.title: Neighbor
daily_content.arabic_text: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيُحْسِنْ إِلَى جَارِهِ

translations.en: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him be good to his neighbor.

daily_content.title: Forgiveness
daily_content.arabic_text: وَلْيَعْفُوا وَلْيَصْفَحُوا ۗ أَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَنْ يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ

translations.en: Let them pardon and overlook. Would you not love for Allah to forgive you?
Seeking knowledge is a duty upon every Muslim.

historical_places.name: Masjid al-Haram
historical_places.description: The Grand Mosque in Makkah, surrounding the Kaaba. The holiest site in Islam.
historical_places.significance: Direction of prayer (Qibla) for all Muslims worldwide. Destination for Hajj and Umrah.

historical_places.name: Masjid an-Nabawi
historical_places.description: The Prophet's Mosque in Madinah, built by Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
historical_places.significance: Second holiest mosque in Islam. Contains the Green Dome marking the Prophet's tomb.

historical_places.name: Masjid al-Aqsa
historical_places.description: The third holiest mosque in Islam, located in Jerusalem.
historical_places.significance: First Qibla of Islam. Site of Prophet Muhammad's Night Journey (Isra and Mi'raj).

historical_places.name: Mount Uhud
historical_places.description: Site of the Battle of Uhud (3 AH / 625 CE) near Madinah.
historical_places.significance: Mountain loved by the Prophet. Site where the Prophet was wounded and 70 companions were martyred.

historical_places.name: Cave of Hira
historical_places.description: Cave on Jabal al-Nur where the first revelation was received by Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
historical_places.significance: Where the first verses of the Quran were revealed: 'Iqra' (Read!).

historical_places.name: Cave of Thawr
historical_places.description: Cave where Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and Abu Bakr (RA) hid during the migration to Madinah.
historical_places.significance: Allah caused a spider to weave a web and a bird to nest at the entrance, concealing them from the Quraysh.

historical_places.name: Mount Arafat
historical_places.description: The plain of Arafat where pilgrims gather on the 9th of Dhul Hijjah.
historical_places.significance: The most important day of Hajj. The Prophet said 'Hajj is Arafah.'

historical_places.name: Quba Mosque
historical_places.description: The first mosque built in Islamic history, founded by Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) upon arrival in Madinah.
historical_places.significance: The Prophet said 'One who performs ablution and prays in it will have the reward of Umrah.'

historical_places.name: Masjid al-Qiblatain
historical_places.description: The mosque where the direction of prayer was changed from Jerusalem to Makkah.
historical_places.significance: Witnessed the revelation changing the Qibla direction during prayer.

historical_places.name: Battle of Badr
historical_places.description: Site of the first major battle in Islamic history (2 AH / 624 CE).
historical_places.significance: Decisive victory for the Muslims against the Quraysh. A turning point in Islamic history.

descriptions.en: Enter the state of Ihram at the Miqat. Men wear two white seamless cloths. Women wear modest clothing. Make the intention for Hajj and recite the Talbiyah.

duas.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكِ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ

translations.en: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Verily all praise, grace and sovereignty are Yours. You have no partner.

descriptions.en: Upon reaching Makkah, perform Tawaf al-Qudum (circumambulation of the Kaaba seven times counter-clockwise).

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ

translations.en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

en: Touching the Black Stone when crowded causing harm
Performing Tawaf inside the Hateem area
Facing the Kaaba while making Tawaf

descriptions.en: Walk seven times between the hills of Safa and Marwah, following the footsteps of Hagar (RA).

en: Running in the green area incorrectly

descriptions.en: On the 8th of Dhul Hijjah, proceed to Mina and spend the day in prayer and remembrance.

en: Leaving Mina before Fajr on the 9th

descriptions.en: The most important day of Hajj. Stand on the plain of Arafat from noon until sunset, making earnest dua and seeking forgiveness. The Prophet said: 'Hajj is Arafah.'

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

translations.en: There is no god but Allah, alone, without partner. His is the sovereignty and His is the praise, and He has power over all things.

en: Spending the day shopping or sleeping instead of making dua
Not combining Dhuhr and Asr prayers

descriptions.en: After sunset on the 9th, proceed to Muzdalifah. Combine Maghrib and Isha prayers. Spend the night in prayer and collect 49 pebbles for the stoning.
On the 10th, 11th, 12th, and optionally 13th, stone the Jamarat (pillars) with 7 pebbles each, starting with the largest (Jamrat al-Aqaba) on the 10th.

translations.en: Allah is the Greatest.

en: Throwing large objects instead of small pebbles

descriptions.en: After stoning on the 10th, sacrifice an animal (Hadi) and shave or trim your hair. Men shave their heads, women trim a fingertip's length.
Return to Makkah to perform Tawaf al-Ifadah (7 circuits around the Kaaba) and Sa'i. This is an essential pillar of Hajj.

en: Delaying Tawaf al-Ifadah beyond the days of Tashreeq unnecessarily

descriptions.en: Before leaving Makkah, perform the Farewell Tawaf (Tawaf al-Wada) as the final act of Hajj.

en: Leaving Makkah without performing Farewell Tawaf
Menstruating women may be excused from Farewell Tawaf

descriptions.en: Enter the state of Ihram at the designated Miqat. Make intention for Umrah and recite the Talbiyah.

duas.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكِ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ

translations.en: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Verily all praise, grace and sovereignty are Yours. You have no partner.

descriptions.en: Perform 7 circuits around the Kaaba counter-clockwise, starting from the Black Stone.

en: Pushing or crowding at the Black Stone

descriptions.en: Walk 7 times between Safa and Marwah.
Men shave their heads or trim, women trim a fingertip's length. This completes Umrah.

hajj_checklist.notes: Ensure validity of at least 6 months from travel date
Obtain through authorized Hajj travel agents
Meningitis, COVID-19, and seasonal flu vaccines required
Mina and Arafat can be cool at night
Bring enough for the entire trip plus extra
Useful for nights in Mina and Muzdalifah
